name: Parkour
about: Joins a game of Parkour that players voted open and runs to the finish. Start it with !parkour in Telegram or the raw command {"cmd":"parkour"}; {"cmd":"parkour","on":false} stops the run and leaves the game. A game the server opened by itself, which pays its winner, is refused. Every game played is recorded in the log parkour-runs.jsonl (Settings, Behavior).
needs: The module (Game, Advanced, Server modules: tweakcraft) and the profile's eventLeave command, which leaves the game.
